notes: Isolates time-order reasoning over a ~8.9 KB / 150-record synthetic timeline delivered inline in shuffled file order (plain mode has no filesystem, so the corpus lives in prompt.md). The answer is three coupled fields (earlier id 65, later id 66, gap 840 min): the planted 840-minute gap is strictly the longest by construction (all other 148 gaps are 15..180 min), so the runner-up is at most 180 min and near-tie guessing fails. Bounding events sit mid-file (file lines 82 and 99 of 150) and are adjacent in time but not in the file, so file-neighbour shortcuts fail. Tier 2: sort-by-timestamp plus 149 exact diffs; strong-model prior 70-90%. Grading scope: final 'FINAL:' line only. False-positive audit: (a) runner-up gap triple, (b) file-adjacent pair, (c) reversed from/to, (d) no FINAL line - all rejected. Leading-zero ids accepted.
